caption: The drawing depicts a shallow, round bowl with smooth, slightly sloped sides and a wide rim, rendered in grayscale with careful shading to suggest metallic or ceramic material. The bowl is centered within a rectangular frame that is drawn with thin, straight lines. In the lower left corner of the rectangle, there is an inset detail showing a simple side-profile outline of the bowl, also enclosed in a smaller rectangle. Both the main illustration and the inset profile use gray pencil or ink, and the background is a plain light color, matching the paper. The signature "V. Garano" appears in the lower right corner of the larger rectangle.
title: Silver Basin
